entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: A vast wilderness in Theros, domain of Nylea, home to wild and magical creatures and the oldest trees in Theros.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane in which the Nessian Wood lies.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Deity whose domain is the Nessian Wood; she allows limited hunting and has killed poachers.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A sprawling polis whose inhabitants live in harmony with the wild and train with animals.

entities.name: Bassara
entities.description: Patrols from Setessa that monitor the Cypress Gates.

entities.name: Cypress Gates
entities.description: A mountain gap serving as an eastern entry to the Nessian Wood, with an ancient Setessan fortress.

entities.name: Enorasi
entities.description: An enormous olive tree planted by Klothys, whose hollow trunk hides an entrance to the Underworld; lair of Arasta.

entities.name: Arasta
entities.description: A cursed dryad trapped in the form of a spider, whose webs conceal the Underworld entrance in the Enorasi.

entities.name: Hunter's Crossing
entities.description: Abandoned tower ruins marking the farthest reach of ancient Setessan expansion.

entities.name: Sperche River
entities.description: The longest river on Theros, running through the Nessian Wood into the Siren Sea.

events.summary: Ancient Setessans carve a fortified stronghold into the mountains to guard the Cypress Gates.
events.quote: Long ago, ancient Setessans carved a fortified stronghold into the mountains to guard the pass.

events.summary: Klothys plants the Enorasi in the Nessian Wood.
